title: Servicing System Reference: Late-Fee Entries on Kestrel Auto Finance Contracts
content:
A late fee on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts is charged once on an installment that is still unpaid after its grace period. It is booked on the loan ledger as a late-fee entry dated the assessment date that names the installment, and the contract's fees due rise by the fee. The borrower then sees the late fee on the loan history and inside the fees due.

## Capability

`assess_late_fee_56686208` books one late-fee charge on the borrower's loan ledger, dated today and tied to the installment named, and raises the contract's fees due by the same amount. It records the amount it is given; it does not work out the amount.

## How it is invoked

This is an agent-side tool. The representative first unlocks `assess_late_fee_56686208` and then calls it with the three parameters below.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `finance_contract_id` | the reference number of the finance contract being charged, as returned by the finance contract lookup for this borrower | identifier |
| `installment_due_date` | the due date of the installment the late fee is charged on, exactly as the contract or loan history shows it | YYYY-MM-DD, no time zone |
| `late_fee_amount` | the late fee being charged | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent |

## Return

On success the tool returns:

- `status`: "late_fee_assessed";
- `finance_txn_id`: the reference number of the new late-fee ledger entry;
- `installment_due_date`: the installment charged (YYYY-MM-DD);
- `late_fee_amount`: the fee booked (USD, 2 decimals);
- `fees_due`: the contract's fees due including this fee (USD, 2 decimals).

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

Called with contract reference FC-1001, installment 2026-04-15 and 24.00, the tool returns status "late_fee_assessed", the new entry's reference number, installment 2026-04-15, late fee 24.00, and fees due that are 24.00 higher than before. The entry appears on the loan history as a late fee for the 2026-04-15 installment.
